endpoint_request.Definition

Defines the wrapper around the data delivery mechanism of the Data Platform.

Available as lseg.data.delivery.endpoint_request.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    url: str,
    method: RequestMethod | str | None = None,
    path_parameters: dict | None = None,
    query_parameters: dict | None = None,
    header_parameters: dict | None = None,
    body_parameters: dict | list[dict] | None = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
url str Yes API endpoint URL.
method RequestMethod | str | None No None HTTP request method.
path_parameters dict | None No None Parameters that can be added to the endpoint URL.
query_parameters dict | None No None HTTP request query parameters.
header_parameters dict | None No None HTTP request header parameters.
body_parameters dict | list[dict] | None No None HTTP request body parameters.

Methods

get_data

Send a request to the Data Platform API directly.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> Response

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

Response

Example

from lseg.data.delivery import endpoint_request
definition_endpoint = endpoint_request.Definition("/data/news/v1/analyze")
definition_endpoint.get_data()

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request directly to the Data Platform API.

async get_data_async(session: Session | None = None) -> Response

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

Response

Example

import asyncio
from lseg.data.delivery import endpoint_request
definition_endpoint = endpoint_request.Definition("/data/news/v1/analyze")
asyncio.run(definition_endpoint.get_data_async())

Example

from lseg.data.delivery import endpoint_request
definition_endpoint = endpoint_request.Definition("/data/news/v1/analyze")

Related types

RequestMethod

Possible values for the request methods:

Name Value Description
RequestMethod.DELETE 'DELETE' DELETE request method.
RequestMethod.GET 'GET' GET request method.
RequestMethod.POST 'POST' POST request method.
RequestMethod.PUT 'PUT' PUT request method.
